digest.component_or_area: external integration test suite / CI workflows
propositions: External integration tests run live against only Anthropic, creating blind spots for Bedrock and OpenAI provider-specific regressions that cannot be caught by CI automation
Provider selection must be a matrix dimension with separate arms per credentialed provider (Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenAI) rather than a single ambient default

Each matrix arm must select its provider via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE pointing to a config file that sets only [llm.model_classes], and an arm with missing credentials must skip loudly rather than read as green

Bedrock authentication on GitHub-hosted runners requires OIDC role assumption to a scoped IAM role, not the EC2 instance-role path used in S7, and must explicitly set both AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION to avoid silent NoRegionError failures
The cfg.model fallback to DEFAULT_MODEL was causing all arms to call Anthropic regardless of overlay, and the ambient default model must also resolve to the declared provider per arm
